issue.title: chezmoi poseidon_chezmoi_isolation_test fails 2 cases since 9430387a made the Mac render a cargo config

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Every push to the chezmoi repo (bbugyi200/dotfiles) has been red since 9430387a
(`feat(cargo): lean dev debug info on the MacBook`, tailnet-h.1): GitHub Actions CI runs
42404199333, 42407106233, 42409538953, 42411507677, and 42413373633 all fail `just test-bash`
with exactly these two cases and nothing else (423 passed, 9 skipped, 2 failed). The run for
a2c680bc, the commit just before 9430387a, was green.

The assertions are deterministic template renders, not timing:
`test_mac_ignores_poseidon_files` asserts `.cargo/config.toml` appears in the rendered
`.chezmoiignore` for `Kellys-MacBook-Pro`, and `test_cargo_config_renders_only_on_athena`
asserts the Mac's `dot_cargo/config.toml.tmpl` render is empty. 9430387a deliberately moved
`.cargo/config.toml` into its own ignore block (ignored unless athena or the Mac) and added a
Mac-only `[profile.dev] debug = "line-tables-only"` block, but did not update this test.
Reproduced locally on athena at 6af21b40 with
`bashunit tests/bash/poseidon_chezmoi_isolation_test.sh` (2 passed, 2 failed). Also reported
independently by bob-cli-ib.4, bob-cli-ib.5, and bob-cli-ib.6 as reproducing on clean bases.

Fix: update the two tests to the new intent. The Mac no longer ignores `.cargo/config.toml`
but still ignores the poseidon files (`bin/poseidon-cache-watch`, sccache, the
poseidon-cache-watch units). The Mac render contains `line-tables-only` and none of athena's
`build-dir` / `sase-rustc-wrapper` lines. Apollo still renders empty. Rename
`test_cargo_config_renders_only_on_athena` to match.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed independently by bob-cli-ib.4, bob-cli-ib.5, and bob-cli-ib.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes), and confirmed by the bob-cli-ib land agent: chezmoi master CI has been red on every push since 9430387a, which is unrelated to the crontab epic.
